acceptanceCriteria: A Corvint command converts a caller-run (or Corvint-run) `playwright test --list --reporter=json` listing into a canonical corvint-playwright-discovery/1 record anchored to immutable Git identities that behavior-adapter accepts.
Refusals for filtered, sharded, errored or out-of-root listings are explicit; a failing-before test covers the round trip.
body: behavior-adapter requires a live-playwright-list discovery record (config anchor plus one execution per test/project) but no Corvint command emits one; adopters hand-build it. Related to the affected-side playwright-discovery/0 producer (V1-1066). Source: beamfall/corvint#717.
title: docs corpus: producer for the corvint-playwright-discovery/1 live-playwright-list record
